title: Blue Monday @ Hal & Mal's
event_description: Weekly blues jam session hosted by the Central Mississippi Blues Society. Musicians are invited to jam with the Blue Monday Band. Features Front Porch acoustic hour followed by full band performance.
event_venue_information:
Hal & Mal's Red Room

Hal & Mal's Red Room hosts this weekly blues jam every Monday night. The venue is a Jackson landmark that has been serving the community since 1985. The Red Room is one of multiple music spaces within the historic GM&O freight depot building.

Event Details

The event features a Front Porch acoustic hour from 7:15-8:15 PM followed by the Blue Monday Band performing from 8:30-11 PM. Admission is $5 at the door ($3 for CMBS members). Free parking available. Cash bar and blues menu offered.

Other Events at Hal & Mal's

Hal & Mal's features live music in multiple rooms throughout the week including Tuesday Night Jazz with the Raphael Semmes Quartet in the Dining Room and various national touring acts in the Red Room and Big Room. The venue also hosts weekly trivia nights and karaoke events.

title: Tuesday Night Jazz @ Hal & Mal's
event_description: Weekly jazz performance featuring the Raphael Semmes Quartet. Enjoy intimate jazz in the dining room while savoring Gulf Coast-centric cuisine.
event_venue_information:
Hal & Mal's Dining Room

Every Tuesday night the Dining Room transforms into an intimate jazz venue featuring the talented Raphael Semmes Quartet. This regular event combines live music with the restaurant's celebrated menu.

Venue Features

The Dining Room at Hal & Mal's offers a more intimate setting compared to the Red Room and Big Room. Guests can enjoy dinner and drinks while experiencing live jazz in a relaxed atmosphere adorned with local memorabilia and photographs.

title: Bluegrass Night @ Hal & Mal's
event_description: Monthly bluegrass performance featuring Tim Avalon and other bluegrass artists. Traditional bluegrass instrumentation and vocals in an intimate setting.
event_venue_information:
Bluegrass at Hal & Mal's

Select Friday nights feature bluegrass performances in the Dining Room. These events showcase traditional bluegrass music with talented local and regional musicians.

About the Venue

Hal & Mal's has been a cornerstone of Jackson's live music scene since 1985 offering everything from blues to bluegrass to rock and jazz across multiple performance spaces.

title: Open Mic + Band @ Soulé Coffee
event_description: Monthly open mic night with full band accompaniment. Performers showcase their skills backed by a complete band. A unique opportunity for musicians to perform with professional support.
venue_address: 2943 Old Canton Road Suite E Jackson MS 39216
event_venue_information:
Soulé Coffee and Bubble Tea Fondren

Soulé Coffee is a modern coffee and bubble tea shop in the heart of Fondren that also serves as a community gathering space for artists and musicians. The venue features a tech-forward self-service experience combined with a commitment to fostering local creativity.

Open Mic Events

Soulé hosts monthly open mic nights where performers can showcase their talents with the support of a full backing band. The $10 admission helps support the local music community.

Community Focus

Beyond coffee and music Soulé serves as a hub for the JXN Artists Business Meetup and other community development initiatives. The space aims to be a change agent for young creators looking to make their mark in Mississippi.
